shared_elements: low-relief animal figure in profile on a flat upright stone face
plain rectangular slab/pillar surface as the carrying field
schematic, shallow-relief carving of a quadruped-like creature
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic profile animal figures worked directly onto flat upright stone faces, and in B one pillar bears a faint quadruped in profile comparable in outline convention to the creatures in A. The decisive difference is density and organisation of content: A is a fully covered field of registers with zigzag bands, repeated crouching creatures and looping serpentine forms, whereas B shows essentially undecorated slabs with a single faint figure plus a plain perforated block, so no shared compositional scheme can be demonstrated.
